                                               ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1 • Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
11 -L in the area bounded by

North Milwaukee Avenue; a line 120.70 feet north of and parallel to West Giddings Street; the alley next
west of and parallel to North Milwaukee Avenue: and a line 170.70 feet north of and parallel to Wesl
Giddings Street;



to those of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property:             4758-4760 North Milwaukee Avenue
                  PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                    TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                        4758-4760 N. Milwaukee



C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District



The Applicant seeks a zoning map amendment to allow for the expansion of the existing a
medical and recreational adult cannabis use. The exterior of the building will not change.
